text_block_list.text:
On my day off, I came to the track to 
train with Narita Brian, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Looks like someone beat us here.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Spe and Suzuka. And a few other familiar 
faces, too...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Why are you wearing your racing 
racewear...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh, Brian.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
What are you doing? Is this some kind of 
event?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No, since it's the new year, I thought we 
could all run together to get ourselves 
into gear.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking that since we're doing 
this, your racewear might be nice...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You came out to run too, Brian? Then let's 
race together, in our racing silks!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Understood, I'll go change.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa!! Your racing outfit looks so cool, 
Brian-san!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I guess that means we need to brace 
ourselves. In that case... this way.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...More importantly, are you ready?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! I've been shivering with 
excitement for a while now!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …………Are you for real?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Honestly. Wear whatever you like, but 
please make sure you do not catch a cold, 
understood?

And so, each harboring their own 
aspirations, everyone dashed across the 
course!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Phew... phew... The air is so clear and 
refreshing.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah...! It'll warm our bodies up, too.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Still, Brian-san's running was just 
incredible, truly!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Right, she was pushing forward even harder 
than usual... Her fighting spirit was 
incredible.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Right?! Did you think so too, Suzuka-san?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It's like I'll get burned if I get too 
close... Her blazing flames are flaring up 
so hot!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Does that racing outfit really carry that 
much meaning after all?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: "...Who knows? It's just—"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: It's not wrong.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Craving more and more, wanting to devour 
everything and set myself ablaze—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
In the sense of burning with hunger, 
you're not wrong.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "...I see. Burn, eatâ"
(Grrumble~~~~...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Starving is just a figure of speech, 
you know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Speaking of grilling food, we have 
some leftover mochi, so would you care to 
join me?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I worked hard during training, so I'm 
pretty hungry now.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Don't go making decisions without me. 
Geez...

And so, the mochi party began at the 
Mejiro estate.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, who wants roasted soybean flour on 
theirs???

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Can I have it?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
How about black honey syrup? There's 
chocolate, honey, and plenty of other 
toppings!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: It's fine just the way it is.
choice_data_list:
You're being pretty cooperative today, 
huh.

You're being pretty cooperative today, 
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Refusing would only be more of a 
hassle.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Man, looks like this year's going to be 
another busy one.

Despite that, Narita Brian somehow looked 
rather satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes, right here!! Can I get some kinako, 
pleaseee?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Good grief...
choice_data_list: Aren't you going to eat any mochi?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I'm not in the mood.

Despite her grumbling, the fact that she 
was willing to join in made me sense just 
how much she'd grown.
